owner_decision: 2026-11-09: the owner chose the slag canyon (concept B) and approved painting the full Brasshollow set into it. 2026-11-10: the owner had a Shipyard painted as a boatworks on the cliff face under the market terrace, its hull on rails running down into the slag river, as the canyon has no water; it was repainted lower the same day, as the first one rose onto the terrace in front of the T3 hall.

generation.tool: imggen: OpenAI Images API, gpt-image-2.6-sunburst, masked edit, quality medium, complexity low

method: Each building is a masked edit of the empty canyon (image 1) with its plot box as the mask and a reference (image 2): a crop of the concept painting for the finished buildings, the next stage's painting for earlier stages. When crop is set, image 1 was that crop of the canyon, scaled to the edit size, so the plot box filled about a third of the frame.

matting.input: 1024x1024, ImageNet mean and std, averaged with the mirrored window
matting.window: the building BiRefNet finds touching the plot in a first look (plot box and paint change over 70, margin 0.4), then margin 0.12, grown by 0.25 on a side the building covers over 0.02 of, at most 4 windows
matting.passes: a building with matte_passes is looked at that many times, each time with what was found (grown by 6 px) painted back to the empty backdrop, and its matte is the union

grounding: Painted into the empty slag canyon on its own plot by a masked edit; the layer is the building as BiRefNet marks it, with a short soft skirt of its painted foundation, and later stages keep the plot's ground line.
curation: Owner-approved slag-canyon set (2026-11-09); layers draw under the stage tint and light, clicks follow the building-only hit mask.
